segments.speaker: penelope
segments.caption: Stranger, you were pitied in this house an hour ago. Now you will be loved in it and honored. Those were my gifts, folded by me, and no living man could have known them who had not stood beside him.
segments.delivery: forensic listener breaking into grief when material details match private memory

segments.speaker: penelope
segments.caption: You swear to me he is near, and comes before this moon is dead. Then hear my own oath, stranger. If he crosses that threshold, no one alive will ever call you beggar again.
